zh.title: 國防部偵獲共機7架次與共艦8艘　其中5架次進入周邊空域
zh.summary: 國防部於8月20日發布動態，偵獲7架次共機與8艘共艦，國軍嚴密監控應處。
body: 國防部於2026年8月20日上午公布最新的共機艦動態統計報告。自8月19日上午6時起至8月20日上午6時止，國軍共計偵獲8艘共艦、6艘公務船以及7架次共機，持續在台灣周邊海空域進行活動。
根據國防部說明，在偵獲的7架次共機當中，有5架次侵擾台灣北部、西南及東部空域。相關軍機活動範圍涵蓋台海周邊多處關鍵區域。
針對共軍兵力活動，國軍持續運用任務機、任務艦以及岸置飛彈系統，對台灣周邊海空情勢實施嚴密監控與妥適應處，確保整體安全。

en.title: Taiwan Defense Ministry Tracks 7 PLA Aircraft and 8 Vessels
en.summary: Taiwan's defense ministry monitored seven PLA aircraft and eight vessels operating around the island on August 20.
body: Taiwan's Ministry of National Defense released its daily report on August 20, 2026, stating that it tracked seven PLA aircraft, eight PLA naval vessels, and six official ships in the air and maritime areas surrounding Taiwan between 6:00 a.m. on August 19 and 6:00 a.m. on August 20.

The defense ministry specified that among the seven PLA aircraft detected, five sorties entered Taiwan's northern, southwestern, and eastern airspace, continuing their operations near the Taiwan Strait.
In response to these military activities, Taiwan's armed forces dispatched mission aircraft and naval vessels while activating land-based missile systems to closely monitor and handle the situation.
